name: page-overview-purpose
goal: Page Overview begins with its short registered description above screenshots while the header stays concise.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Pages need one short purpose paragraph inside Overview above screenshot evidence. Keep the header concise, route details in Contract, and other tabs unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing entity overview and visual-overview scenarios only assert evidence placement and concise header copy. Strengthen their existing page cases to require the registered purpose before screenshots at current and selected commits across all three widths.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: d09a5276 fails the unchanged standardized page overview tests and all three browser widths: missing registered purpose. Frozen record 4b193bd4fa1c3b0fe40fc075395f711b969b1a5f0c74667f63817d195cf05c47 preserves the failing assertion and before captures.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 79bbbf3e renders the registered page purpose as semantic text at the start of Overview using the existing lead style; other entity categories and tabs are unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Frozen record b635a1e50287aa70e496676937cfe5c48b3b54ac3f304f0f6642b5b4744d02fe passes the unchanged 13 unit assertions and 3 browser cases at 79bbbf3e; before and after captures retained.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Description product 79bbbf3e and final route revision 556d0de6 preserve the unchanged tests from d09a5276. Latest frozen green record 59b1ecf9474beafbdc3935b7327e97e22709b871cee5a79066eadfd33fb14bee passes 13 unit tests and three browser cases; matching before/after captures were inspected. Final 556d0de6 passes the complete Reports check: 604 tests, formatting, types, lint, three builds and app audit. Manual browser proof covers all six page tabs, current and selected commit links, and loaded desktop/tablet/mobile captures with no browser console errors. Eighteen gallery assets match inspected originals. Root check passes formatting, types, lint and kernel checks/build, then stops with 889 passed, 25 skipped and the existing entityMeasure/entityShown ownership guard failure. The helpers, ledger and guard are unchanged from a73ea58b. Later aggregate stages were not reached. Root audit also reports an unchanged 221-line test against the 220 limit. Jev review is incomplete without its dedicated credential. Full verification and report publication remain pending.
